title: Atrazine degradation by aqueous ferrate(VI) activated with sulfite vs. thiosulfate: performance, products, and pathways
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50682-50691
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07813J, Paper
Open Access

Qin Guo, Chaoting Guan, Yi Yang, Yang Zhou, Jin Jiang
Analysis of ATZ’s transformation products elucidated that sulfur-reductants (e.g., sulfite and thiosulfate) can enhance ferrate (Fe(VI)) oxidation toward organic contaminants by generating distinct reactive species.
